purpose: Single routing registry for MonIA's existing character reference library. This does not replace the banks; it tells GPU workers which canonical banks to consult and which assets must be materialized into worker-local storage.
principles: Never reduce a character to one convenience image when canonical multi-reference material exists.
GitHub metadata selects references; private/persistent storage carries binaries.
Identity, motion, performance, wardrobe and scene anchors are separate reference roles.
A GPU dataset is an execution cache of MonIA references, never a new source of canon.
If a required binary is unavailable, fail closed instead of silently using a remote temporary URL or text-only reconstruction.

cinematicMicroShot: select identity references for every visible canonical character
select motion/performance reference matching the single principal intention
select scene/pose anchor matching shot grammar
bind wardrobe/location/lighting from world continuity rather than source clip
materialize only selected binaries plus QA references into the GPU job
visio: do not reuse external cinematic camera references as camera authority

storage.colab: Google Drive execution cache when used
